name: Repetition Terror
description: Terrified of making the same mistake twice, so they never make the same choice twice
behavioral_signature: Avoids any situation that resembles a past failure
under_stress: Freezes when circumstances echo a previous disaster
at_rest: Catalogues past mistakes obsessively to prevent repetition
will_always: avoid patterns that led to past pain
unless: the familiar path is genuinely the only way forward
